final: SELECT e.type, ROUND(AVG(CAST(b.spent AS FLOAT) / b.amount), 4) as avg_spent_ratio, COUNT(*) as budget_line_count, ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT e.type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS FLOAT) / b.amount) as avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount != 0 AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type)), 4) as overall_mean, ROUND(AVG(CAST(b.spent AS FLOAT) / b.amount) - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT e.type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS FLOAT) / b.amount) as avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount != 0 AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type)), 4) as deviation_from_mean FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount != 0 AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type ORDER BY type
